_provenance: Extracted from laquereric/magentic-stack at 7324845 (2026-09-04). One-way extraction: this copy is reference, the monorepo follows it pinned.
covers: Per-seam authority (ADR 0050:108-112, gap 20). LIVE vs DECIDED-UNBUILT are separate lists. A kind=server file from cpcp_callers.json must belong to a live seam. Domain writes are admitted only at BACK (ADR 0056: BACK and BACKJOB write; BACKJOB does not mount /_cpcp).

live.authoritative_for: domain state admitted over rails-cpcp. BACK is a declared domain writer with BACKJOB (ADR 0056). The far side of this seam is BACK.
local credential routing (switchyard.route, cpcp.ready, cid). Not domain state. Not ROLE=bus.
provider secret storage and brokering (ADR 0046). Read-back asymmetry: config-admin may put/list, never get. Not domain state. Live (row 4); REST stand-in retired.
async retain/publish of metadata derived from BACK's operation journal (rows 72, 73). Not an event store. Not RES. Not domain state. SwitchYard CPCP endpoint is this seam, not a fifth one (row 18).
next-boot placement intentions against the row-39 closed set (rows 8, 39, 41). Records where stores bind; never applies live. Not domain state. Not the journal.

what MIND read and proposed: the last reading, its ground, and whether BACK committed it. Adapter surface over NOOA outputs, not a second authority (ROW10_SLICE1). Not domain state. Not the journal. Not placement.

not_a_seam.because: OpenAI-compatible chat completions; no /_cpcp. Node today, target Rust (row 11).

layers._why: Row 105 (2026-09-02a review section 4): each layer names its authority and what it must not decide. An adapter may translate only what it names.

http.authoritative_for: request routing to an origin, method semantics, status code, headers, auth challenges, content negotiation, caching directives, conditional requests, intermediary-visible behavior, transport observability
http.must_not_decide: JSON-RPC method meaning, CPCP result/error vocabulary, domain authorization rules, RDF/SHACL semantics

cpcp.authoritative_for: request/response envelope, versioning, method dispatch, named params, correlation, result/error shape, JSON-LD context and profile terms
cpcp.must_not_decide: HTTP status meanings, cacheability, auth challenge syntax, resource lifecycle, whether a route is RESTful

rest.authoritative_for: URI/resource identity, uniform-interface use, safe/idempotent expectations, representations, links, conditionals, lifecycle where claimed
rest.must_not_decide: internal procedure names, envelope conformance, vocabulary meaning, authorization policy beyond HTTP-visible signaling

w3id.authoritative_for: durable identity and meaning of published shapes, properties, classes, operation concepts; term versioning and governance
w3id.must_not_decide: executable dispatch, endpoint location, auth decisions, HTTP status, cache policy, proof of shape conformance
